{{Quote|He was among the best of us...|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], speaking of Master Poof|<ref name="Star Wars: Zam Wesell">''[[Star Wars: Zam Wesell]]''</ref>}}
The '''Funeral of Yarael Poof''' took place after [[Yarael Poof/Legends|Master Poof]] sacrificed himself in order to protect [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] from [[Ashaar Khorda]]; an [[Annoo-dat]] radical. Poof's body was recovered after he had been stabbed by Khorda, who also died from his injuries. His remains were then brought to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], and brought to the [[Jedi Temple Pyre room|Jedi Pyre]] for the service. The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his apprentice, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and the three Quermian Jedi [[Kindee Ya]], [[Vinian Ska]] and [[Loo Raelo]] were present, with [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] eulogizing.
